task_completion.description: Open the specified rocket file in OpenRocket.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The OpenRocket application is visible with the file 'recovery_analysis.ork' loaded in the title bar or file path.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the recovery components (Main and Drogue parachutes) in the rocket design tree.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Rocket design' tab is active, and parachute components (e.g., Main, Drogue) are highlighted or selected in the component tree.

task_completion.description: Increase the diameters of the parachutes to optimize for a safer (slower) descent.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Parachute configuration' or 'Component properties' dialog is open, showing diameter values being increased from the initial small values (0.254m/0.076m) to larger values.

task_completion.description: Run a flight simulation to calculate the new descent rates and ground hit velocity.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Flight simulations' tab is active, and a simulation is executed, showing a green checkmark or updated status.

task_completion.description: Check the simulation results to ensure the ground hit velocity is within safe limits.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Simulation results' window or a plot is visible, showing the 'Ground hit velocity' or 'Vertical velocity' at landing.

task_completion.description: Export or save the descent rate analysis report to the specified text file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal shows the file '/home/ga/Documents/exports/descent_analysis_report.txt' containing descent rate data or ground hit velocity.

integrity.description: The agent used the OpenRocket GUI to modify the rocket design rather than just editing the XML file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with OpenRocket dialogs and input fields.

integrity.description: The agent actually ran a simulation in OpenRocket to get the data, not just guessing values.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Flight simulations' table shows a simulation entry with a timestamp corresponding to the task execution.

integrity.description: The report was generated based on the modified design, not pre-written.
integrity.visual_evidence: The values in the final report match the results shown in the OpenRocket simulation UI.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The initial rocket file has dangerously small parachutes: Main diameter is 0.254m and Drogue is 0.076m. To achieve a safe descent, the Main diameter should be increased (the original design was 1.0668m, and the verifier expects at least 0.7m). The final report must be saved to /home/ga/Documents/exports/descent_analysis_report.txt. Ground hit velocity should be significantly reduced from the initial state.
